name: Restaurant
looksLike: a site showing a menu opening hours and directions
a cafe page with food prices and table reservations
a website for finding somewhere to eat
definition: A website that helps guests decide whether and how to visit a food business by showing its menu, prices, opening hours, location, and booking or ordering options.
goal: Help guests find practical dining information and plan a visit.
audience: People choosing a place to eat

sections.name: Welcome and visit
sections.purpose: Show the food offering, location, and main guest action.

sections.name: Menu
sections.purpose: Present readable dishes, prices, and dietary information.

sections.name: Hours and reservations
sections.purpose: Explain opening times and booking or ordering options.

sections.name: Contact and access
sections.purpose: Provide directions, accessibility details, and contact information.

mustHave: A clear way to ask about dietary needs

prompts.short: Build a restaurant site with a readable menu, prices, current hours, location, and reservation options.
prompts.detailed: Build a restaurant website for people choosing a place to eat. Help guests find practical dining information and plan a visit. Include welcome and visit, menu, hours and reservations, contact and access. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Readable text menus with prices.
